components.css: .ds-essay{color:var(--ink,#132646);font-family:var(--sans,'Hanken Grotesk',sans-serif);line-height:1.5}.ds-essay time{color:var(--muted,#626e81);font-size:13px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.ds-essay h2{margin:8px 0 0;font-size:22px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:-.015em;line-height:1.3;text-wrap:pretty}.ds-essay h2 a{color:var(--ink,#132646);text-decoration:none;transition:color 180ms ease-out}.ds-essay h2 a:hover{color:var(--link,#244dcc)}.ds-essay p{margin:8px 0 0;color:var(--secondary,#43536c);font-size:16px;line-height:1.5;max-width:70ch}.ds-essay a:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--link,#244dcc);outline-offset:6px;border-radius:2px}.ds-essay+.ds-essay{position:relative;margin-top:24px;padding-top:24px}.ds-essay+.ds-essay:before{content:'';position:absolute;top:0;left:0;width:208px;max-width:40%;height:1px;background:var(--rule,#dae1e8)}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-essay h2 a{transition:none}}.ds-entry-action{display:inline-flex;gap:8px;align-items:center;min-height:44px;margin-top:8px;color:var(--link,#244dcc);font-family:var(--sans,'Hanken Grotesk',sans-serif);font-size:15px;line-height:1.5;text-decoration:none}.ds-entry-arrow{flex-shrink:0;width:20px;height:20px;transition:transform 280ms var(--ease-out,cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1))}.ds-entry-action:hover{text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:.2em}.ds-entry-action:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--link,#244dcc);outline-offset:6px;border-radius:2px}.ds-entry-action:hover .ds-entry-arrow,.ds-entry-action:focus-visible .ds-entry-arrow{transform:translateX(5px)}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-entry-arrow{transition:none;transform:none!important}}

narrative.overview:
A scientific monograph's dust jacket informs the visual language: mist-blue cover surfaces, navy ink, confident lettering, and plain image crops. Generous space and an unboxed writing index give the work a calm, personal setting.

Typography carries the hierarchy. Hanken Grotesk handles restrained headings and navigation; Source Serif 4 gives sustained prose its own reading rhythm. The interface stays flat, with small directional movement on essay links.
keyCharacteristics: Mist-blue cover surfaces and near-white reading paper.
Restrained sans-serif headings and titles, with serif article prose.
Square image crops, open text entries, and short dividing rules.
Text-led navigation with visible keyboard focus and restrained arrow motion.

rules.name: The Link Blue Rule
rules.body: Use blue to identify links and interaction states; essay titles begin in navy and turn blue on hover.

rules.name: The Two Type Roles Rule
rules.body: Keep Hanken Grotesk on headings and interface text, and Source Serif 4 on long-form prose.

rules.name: The Flat Surface Rule
rules.body: Use tonal surfaces, spacing, and rules for separation; retain the unboxed treatment of writing entries.

dos: Do preserve the two type roles and self-hosted font files.
Do keep writing entries open, with hierarchy established by type, whitespace, and short rules.
Do keep focus outlines visible and honor reduced-motion preferences.
Do contain wide equations, tables, and code within the article measure without clipping their content.
donts: Don't turn the writing index into a grid of raised or rounded cards.
Don't repeat the author's name or Writing heading in an oversized homepage hero.
Don't replace the square portrait crop or the inline SVG directional cues with decorative framing or glyph icons.
